findings.issue: el santo reads as a holy person; the token is the common noun holiness/sanctuary, not a human participant
debajo de locks the preposition as physical underneath; the lemma also licenses in his place
entra is simple present; the token is qal imperfect, which also licenses a future coming

notes: Seven days, the priest as wearer, the 3mp object, from his sons, and tent of meeting to minister match the tokens.
